[package]
name = "kvhttp"
version = "1.0.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "In-memory HTTP/1.1 key-value server"
license = "MIT"
publish = false

[dependencies]
bytes = "1"
http-body-util = "0.1"
hyper = { version = "1", features = ["server", "http1"] }
hyper-util = { version = "0.1", features = ["tokio"] }
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "net", "macros", "signal"] }

[profile.release]
lto = true
codegen-units = 1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized release binary and places it at ./app.
# Dependencies are fetched from crates.io by cargo, pinned by Cargo.lock.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

command -v cargo >/dev/null || { echo "build.sh: cargo is required" >&2; exit 1; }
cargo build --release --locked
cp target/release/kvhttp app
chmod +x app
